spanish: Y cuando hiere varón ojo de su siervo o ojo de su sierva, y lo echa a perder, a libre lo enviará debajo de su ojo.

findings.issue: H8478 is only marked as a preposition, so under and in place of stay open. «debajo de» resolves it to a place under the eye and drops the substitution sense.

notes: The rest of the clause keeps the licensed participants, number, and stems.
